description: Real-ESRGAN x4plus super-resolution model, QNN-quantized fp16 for HTP inference.
_comment: No pre-compiled QNN context binary is bundled or auto-downloaded. Users convert PyTorch weights (RealESRGAN_x4plus.pth) to a QNN context binary via QAI Hub Compile Job or AIMET — see SKILL.md. 'download_configs' is intentionally empty; the App Builder weight-download use case surfaces a 'no downloadable weights' signal for this pack. Legacy readers should honor 'user_provided'; new readers should honor 'provisioning' == 'user-provided'.

assets.description: HTP-quantized Real-ESRGAN x4plus (input [1,3,480,640] NCHW, fp16). User-provided; convert via QAI Hub or AIMET — see setup_guide.
Lower-memory fallback tile (input [1,3,360,480] NCHW, fp16). Loaded automatically if the 480x640 model fails NPU allocation. Optional.
